author: Arnav
problem: In a stadium section, the front row has first_row seats and each row behind it has extra more seats than the row in front of it. Return the total number of seats in a section with rows rows.
bug_description: Loops r over range(1, rows + 1) instead of range(rows), so every row gets one extra step of seats (the front row has first_row + extra).

comments.accurate: Adds up the seats row by row, starting from the front row's count
comments.wrong_behavior: Sums rows 1 through rows, where row r has first_row plus r * extra seats
comments.wrong_location: Row loop verified; check that a negative extra can't give a row fewer than zero seats
